mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW 745e engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A replacement B58B30C engine for a BMW 745e typically costs £3,500-£5,500 for a used unit, £5,000-£6,500 for a reconditioned unit, and £5,500-£8,000 for a fully rebuilt engine with a 12-month warranty. Supply and fit adds approximately £780-£1,040 in specialist labour (12-16 hours at £65/hr).

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of B58 coolant system failure in a 745e?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common signs are a low coolant warning light, visible coolant puddles under the car, and engine overheating. Other symptoms include a sweet smell from the engine bay, fluctuating temperature gauge, white steam from under the bonnet, and reduced heater performance.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a BMW 745e?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical 745e is worth £25,000-£45,000, making a rebuilt engine (£5,500-£8,000) a sound investment if the car is otherwise in good condition. The 745e's high retained value compared to older 7 Series models means replacement is almost always financially viable.

mainEntity.name: How long does a BMW 745e engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most BMW 745e engine replacements take 2-4 days for supply and fit at a specialist garage. The B58 is a relatively straightforward engine to remove and refit, but the hybrid system adds complexity.

mainEntity.name: Do BMW 745e replacement engines come with a warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - all rebuilt and reconditioned BMW 745e engines supplied through EnginesMarket include a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. Used engines typically have a 3-6 month warranty depending on the supplier. Extended warranty options are available with some specialists.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the 745e and the 740e?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 740e used a 2.0-litre four-cylinder turbo engine producing 326 hp. The 745e replaced it with a 3.0-litre six-cylinder B58 producing 394 hp - a significant upgrade in power, refinement and performance. The 745e is quicker (5.2s vs 5.4s 0-62 mph) and more refined.

historyTimeline.h2: BMW 7 Series 745e - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The BMW 745e debuted in 2019 as part of the G11/G12 7 Series Life Cycle Impulse (LCI) update, replacing the four-cylinder 740e with a more powerful six-cylinder plug-in hybrid powertrain. It paired BMW's renowned B58 3.0-litre turbocharged straight-six with an electric motor, offering a compelling blend of luxury, performance and efficiency.

milestones.description: B58B30C, 3.0-litre inline-six turbo petrol + electric motor, 286 hp (210 kW) combustion + 113 hp electric, 394 hp system output, G11/G12 LCI launch
745Le (long wheelbase) and 745Le xDrive variants introduced alongside standard 745e
B58B30M0 variant introduced for xDrive models with revised hybrid calibration
Production ends (February 2022); replaced by G70-generation 750e xDrive

commonProblems.h2: BMW 7 Series 745e Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW 745e is powered by the B58B30C - one of BMW's most robust modern engines - paired with a plug-in hybrid system. While the B58 is significantly more reliable than older BMW turbo engines, it has a few well-documented weak points, primarily around the cooling system.Rebuilt B58B30C engines supplied through EnginesMarket include upgraded cooling system components, fresh gaskets and seals, and a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Coolant System Leaks - Why the BMW 7 Series 745e B58B30C Loses Coolant
problems.rootCause: The B58's plastic water pump, expansion tank and thermostat housing can develop cracks over time due to heat cycling. Coolant leaks are the most frequently reported issue across the B58 family.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace electric water pump, thermostat, coolant flush
repairOptions.longevity: Preventative - do this before it fails

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace cracked expansion tank, hoses, coolant
repairOptions.longevity: If visible coolant loss or warning light

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, new water pump, thermostat, upgraded cooling components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If overheating has caused head gasket or block damage

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical 745e (2019-2022) is worth approximately £25,000-£45,000 depending on mileage, condition and whether it's a standard or long-wheelbase variant [THIRD-PARTY - Parkers/Auto Trader market observation]. - Vehicle worth under ~£5,000: repair or used engine typically makes more sense than a full rebuilt unit. - Vehicle worth ~£5,000-£8,000: evaluate both; reconditioned is viable if keeping the car 2+ years. - Vehicle worth ~£8,000-£15,000: reconditioned/rebuilt usually justifies the premium via warranty and reliability. - Vehicle worth £15,000+: replacement cost is typically small relative to vehicle value.
problems.recommendation: The B58's cooling system is its Achilles' heel - replace the water pump and expansion tank preventatively at around 60,000-70,000 miles if you're keeping the car. It's far cheaper than repairing an overheated engine. If your 745e has already overheated, get a compression test done immediately; if the head gasket is compromised, a rebuilt engine is the safest route.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt B58B30C BMW 7 Series 745e engine prices

problems.h4: Excessive Oil Consumption - BMW 7 Series 745e B58B30C Oil Burning
problems.rootCause: Some B58 engines develop oil consumption issues due to PCV valve failure or, in rarer cases, valve stem seal wear. This can lead to blue smoke on startup and the need for frequent top-ups.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace PCV valve and associated hoses
repairOptions.longevity: First-line fix - often resolves oil consumption
If PCV replacement doesn't resolve the issue

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, new PCV, valve stem seals, piston rings, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: If oil consumption is severe and engine is high-mileage

problems.recommendation: Start with a PCV valve replacement - it's the most common cause of oil consumption on the B58 and the cheapest fix. If oil consumption persists, have a specialist perform a leak-down test to determine whether valve stem seals or piston rings are the root cause. A rebuilt engine with new valve stem seals and piston rings is the definitive solution.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt B58B30C BMW 7 Series 745e engine prices

problems.h4: High-Voltage Hybrid Battery Degradation - BMW 745e Electric Range Loss
problems.rootCause: The 12 kWh lithium-ion battery pack naturally degrades over time, reducing electric-only range. Battery cells can also fail individually, triggering warning lights and reduced performance.

repairOptions.tier: Battery health check and cell balancing
repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Diagnostic scan, cell balancing, software reset

repairOptions.longevity: If battery is severely degraded or multiple cells failed

problems.recommendation: Hybrid battery degradation is inevitable but typically gradual. If your 745e's electric range has dropped noticeably, start with a diagnostic health check. Individual module replacement is often more cost-effective than a full pack replacement. Note that a healthy battery is essential for the 745e's 34-36 mile electric range - without it, you're effectively driving a heavier, less efficient petrol 7 Series.
